shortDescription: Indonesian palm oil tycoon Franky Oesman Widjaja resigned from the role of president commissioner of edible oil major Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology IDX:SMAR, the company said in a filing to the stock exchange.

children: Indonesian palm oil tycoon Franky Oesman Widjaja resigned from the role of president commissioner of edible oil major Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology
, the company said in a filing to the stock exchange.
Shareholders approved David Fernando Audy as his replacement after an extraordinary general meeting on Tuesday
Franky's resignation is "part of a regular review of leadership and governance processes," the company told Reuters on Wednesday
Franky, 68, remains the chairman and chief executive officer of Golden Agri-Resources
Franky belongs to the Widjaja family; his father Eka Tjipta Widjaja founded Sinar Mas, one of Indonesia's largest conglomerates
The resignation follows Franky's September resignation from the conglomerate's mining arm Dian Swastatika Sentosa

After global index provider MSCI warned last month it could downgrade Indonesia's market to "standalone" status, the financial regulator ordered fines for market participants involved in trading violations concerning three listed firms; Dian Swastatika Sentosa was one of the firms
Last month, Singapore summoned several tycoons over Indonesia's worst forest fires in more than a decade and the resulting transboundary haze that engulfed the city-state
Franky attended the meeting, Singapore's Straits Times newspaper reported
